office: the Passport Section of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration
note: One fee by processing time for any citizen, first passport or renewal (the brochure gives no age bands; minors under 18 need a parent's or guardian's consent). A lost, stolen or damaged passport carries a penalty of 100 dollars the first time and 300 the second. The validity isn't given. Read through the fetch tool's saved copy, since the ministry's server answers curl with 406.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration, Kiribati, Immigration Division, Passport Services brochure (March 2026)
sources.said: KIRIBATI PASSPORT ... Who Can Apply: All citizens of Kiribati – first-time applicants or renewals ... Minors (under 18years of age): Require parental or guardian consent ... Passport fees and processing time: Priority/ Urgent (1 day) - $112.50 Expedited (3 days) - $98.40 Standard (5 days) - $84.40 Normal/ regular (10 days) - $56.25 ... For lost, stolen and damaged passports, penalties apply as follows: 1st time: $100 2nd time: $300
